name: Sprint 0: inception

shipped: 30 requirements and 11 deliverables traced to the brief; facts file
ADR-000..006 incl. delegation controls, demo architecture, meeting format, claims policy
Nine-team roster, budget and model tiers, playbooks, SDLC
Fabric tooling ported; RTM, claims-merge and contract validator with tests (6/6)

goal: Brief decomposed into a traceable spec; org, delegation controls, contracts and tooling in place

went_well: Independent review accepted 3/3 first pass; separation of duties held even for the orchestrator's own work
Reviewer caught a real spec conflict (REQ-09 wrap time vs ADR-005)
went_badly: First Sprint 1 launch lost to an account usage limit: all 7 manager agents and the S0 reviewer failed within ~75s; no work lost but a full relaunch was needed
Claims register needed sharding after the fact: one shared file would have collided under parallel tickets
